changelog: Fixes Jellyfin 12.1 playback indexing while preserving required Movie Name-trailer filenames. Trailer Reel now creates space-free relative symlink aliases with non-extra names for its hidden Jellyfin library.
description: Maintains a local catalog of recent and upcoming movie trailers and plays same-genre trailers before movies.
name: Trailer Reel
overview: Recent and upcoming same-genre movie trailers as Jellyfin prerolls.
